pages.title: Legend of the Wingguard
pages.text: Long ago, merchants told of a dragonkin swordswoman. She travelled with companions and fought like a dancer, rising and falling on her wings. Long after they parted ways, some still spoke of her swordsmanship.
This charm, made with an amphithere feather, carries on her art. Humanoid lightning dragons trained to wield weapons can learn her moves from it.

pages.title: Wing Thrust
pages.text: She crouches, then lunges with a wingbeat and knocks her foe upward.$(br2)Each new foe gives her an opening. Leaving combat or using her breath lets her strike again.$(br2)Ordinary melee weapons work, except axes and tridents. Longswords and katanas have their own moves.

pages.title: Waterfowl Sweep
pages.text: From stage IV, a lightning dragon wearing the charm can leap toward a distant foe with a katana. She glides like a waterfowl, then turns on the way down to sweep foes aside with her tail.$(br2)She needs room to spread her wings, so this move is hard to use in tight caves.

pages.title: Through the Arrow Rain
pages.text: Under fire, your companion raises her longsword and advances. Projectiles stopped by her sword have a fifty-fifty chance of flying back at the attacker.$(br2)Deflection raises that chance further.$(br2)A usable offhand shield still takes priority.
